# bugsink_team (Resource)

A Bugsink team.

~> **`terraform destroy` fails by design.** Bugsink has no API to delete a team. Deleting this resource always fails with a diagnostic explaining how to run `terraform state rm` instead. Do not use this resource in any workflow that assumes destroy succeeds unconditionally (e.g. ephemeral or CI-provisioned environments).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# NOTE: terraform destroy fails by design on this resource - Bugsink has
# no API to delete a team. See the resource documentation before adopting
# it in any workflow that assumes destroy always succeeds.
resource "bugsink_team" "platform" {
  name       = "platform"
  visibility = "discoverable"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name.

### Optional

- `visibility` (String) Team visibility (e.g. `joinable`, `discoverable`, `hidden`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Team ID (UUID), assigned by Bugsink.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Teams are imported by their remote UUID.
terraform import bugsink_team.platform f604b574-942c-4097-9d92-8684fa38d8d2
```
